extraction_text: The district will coordinate a mixed ability and mixed level voluntary users group of teachers and district administrator to continue the discussion about the effective use of technology. This group will foster communication and provide two-way dialogue as the school district works to increase efficiency in technology use and examine streamlining paperwork into the future.
